100.name: Forgotten Depths
100.description: Sit down, my child, and listen close. The ocean is a wonder, the foaming waves that reach our peaceful shores a deceitful invitation. For what lies beneath that endless blue is a world beyond our imagining. Of kingdoms ruined and monsters fierce, floating down in those forgotten depths.

101.name: Galactic
101.description: The War of the Broken Moon has ravaged our galaxy for near a hundred cycles. And still... there is no end in sight.

102.name: Glacial
102.description: It is dangerous to venture out in the cold, for who knows what lurks within these frozen lands…

103.name: Lunar New Year
103.description: It's time to look back, to celebrate with family and friends, to join together and remember all that has happened, the good and the bad. And as the fireworks light up the night sky, we look forward to a new year filled with wonderful memories with the ones we hold dear.

104.name: Order of the Lotus
104.description: Tomes of Ionian myth speak of the venerable Order of the Lotus. Formed when mortals settled in the First Lands, the Order spent generations cultivating the secrets of immortality. Indeed, they were the only group to achieve the pure reincarnation of their spirits. As graceful and transient as ripples in the sea, Order of the Lotus disciples protect the First Lands without fear of facing this life or the next.

105.name: PAX
105.description: To those about to game, we salute you.

106.name: Folded Edges
106.description: A sedge of cranes glides through the sky, the canvas of sun and clouds a beautiful backdrop to their flight. The trees too, and the grass, are made of this self-same material, a parchment pressed with phenomenal power, forming this papercraft world.

107.name: Piltover Customs
107.description: Looking for a souped-up ride? Look no further. (Mileage may vary.)

108.name: The Badge
108.description: In the criminal justice system, there are those who bend the law and those who break it. The dedicated officers at the RPD investigate the city's most heinous crimes to bring the worst offenders to justice. These are their stories...

109.name: Highway Heretics
109.description: In the radioactive ashes of the old world, wasteland warriors, vicious Vandals, and scrappy survivors war with one another for control over all that's left.

10.name: Arclight
10.description: Across the heavens and spanning all of creation, the Agents of Light wage an eternal battle against an unyielding darkness.

110.name: Soulstealer
110.description: Souls are life, light, power—and in a world without mercy, they are stolen and consumed by remorseless masters of death.

111.name: Super Galaxy
111.description:
//EMERGENCY BROADCAST, ALL CHANNELS//
The Galaxy Threat Level has been raised to CRIMSON. [REDACTED] is under attack by [REDACTED]. HQ estimates [REDACTED] hours before total destruction, with collateral damage likely on neighboring systems. Super Galaxy ACTIVATE!

112.name: Thunder Lord
112.description: Mankind are not the only ones who fight bitter wars over petty squabbles. Once, before our time, two gods—two brothers—took up arms against each other, shaping the very land with the desolation of their battle.

113.name: Triumphant
113.description: Rise to the competition and emerge triumphant!

114.name: Winter Sports
114.description: Nothing brings out the best from competitive athletes like the prospect of getting a little frostbite.

116.name: Neon Strata
116.description: Few know of the Foreglow, and even fewer have seen its volatile neon flames. Normally a cosmic balancing force, something has tipped the scales, causing realms to collapse and funnel the Foreglow's power into single beings. Now known as Empyreans, these otherworldly forces of nature blaze a trail through the realms, each with their own agenda. The fire is spreading, with no end in sight.

117.name: Tales of Borealis
117.description: Have you heard the stories of the Aurora? Cold and dark they can be, but if you're brave enough you'll find warmth and majesty grander than any dream you've had. So sit yourself by the fire and come listen to these Tales of Borealis...

118.name: Storycraft
118.description: Stories, myths, legends: within each lies a world unto itself, where characters act out their trials and tribulations over and over as their tales are told and retold.

119.name: Lancer
119.description: The ancient Lancers were marvels beyond compare in their time, built to protect the realm in its greatest hours of need. As time marches on and the giants sleep, the secrets of their construction have long since disappeared... but hope remains that they will answer the call.

11.name: Battlecast
11.description: The glorious revolution is here! Assembling an army of machines with living brains, Viktor marches against the combined forces of his enemies—with only a scrappy human-led resistance keeping him from total world domination.

120.name: Fallen World
120.description: When magic is lost, ash and despair reign in its stead. When the knights of that cursed order fall, what will rise in their place?

121.description: Between the rigid cliques, awkward group projects, and cheesy holidays, school was rough but routine. But getting lovestruck wasn't in the syllabus, and it's gonna make things way more complicated.

122.name: Forsaken Hymn
122.description: Within this ruined world of breaths and glass, where prayers go unanswered and vows are challenged, the only thing one can have faith in is this: a single breath can change one's life.

123.name: Winged Reign
123.description: Pixies, nixies, hobs, redcaps, and more call the Faerie Queendoms home: all creatures of pure natural magic and ethereal beauty that delight in moonlight revels, mellifluous song, and tricksy dealings.

124.name: Inkshadow Uprising
124.description: Rabadon City thrives on magic. Whoever controls magic, controls Rabadon. And the Cabal's control is absolute. Any who resist are brought to heel or eliminated… but an Uprising is coming. Armed with dangerous magic inked directly into their skin, these rebels seek to topple the Cabal and give the city back to its people—or die trying.

125.name: Magicae Prismatica
125.description: Long ago, in a time beyond all living memory, the existence of magic was swept away from the universe. Life moved on, but some worlds could not, and as years turned to decades and centuries, nature began to rebalance itself. Finally the time has come, and now magic is ready to make its return, though not in the form that anyone expects.

126.name: Soul Fighter
126.description: From across the globe, those with awakened souls are granted invitation to fight in... the Tournament of Souls! It sits as king above all entertainment, a televised spectacle with no equal! Fighters face off in 1v1 battles in the ring, until only one remains to receive their prize: the deepest desire of their soul! And I'll be here, announcing it all!

127.name: Concrete Canvas
127.description: Art and magic twine through the urban streets of Styxbridge city, home to monsters, spirits, ghosts, and ghouls of all stripes.

128.name: Sueño de Vida
128.description: Life and death may be the only true constants in the universe, but the one thing that can match their power is family. Life cannot exist without death, and death cannot exist without life, but the bonds of family are strong enough to ensure no spirit is truly forgotten.

129.name: Fury and Fang
129.description: Embrace instinct. Unleash aggression. Demand respect.

130.name: Mealtime Melee
130.description: Who says you can't play with your food?

131.name: Hall of Legends
131.description: To avoid being erased from history forever, many risk their lives to become a Risen Legend—a warrior recognized by the gods who birthed this world. Those who succeed are bestowed with unfathomable power and entrusted to represent the gods that chose them.

133.name: Super Planet Force Savers
133.description: When danger appears and help is desperately needed, there is only one group that can answer the call. Standing at the ready, they tap into their Hyperguise suits and leap into action with transformed strength, agility, and sensational powers. They will fight. They will endure. They are the Super Planet Force Savers, and they are here to defend the galaxy!

136.name: Echoes of the Deep
136.description: There are no heroes here, only the damned who see too clearly. From unmarked tombs to the lightless deep, cursed heroes confront the very nature of evil—festering, eternal, and yearning to be unleashed.

137.name: Umbral Crown
137.description: In the shadow of the underworld, kingdoms rise and fall. Death is only the beginning…far worse lies in wait.

138.name: Howling Road
138.description: Praise the open road, howling and free! On its back we ride eternal, heralds of chrome and fury. Praise the moon, mother of Quicksilver! It is she who feeds our engines, whose tears burn white-hot through man, monster, and machine. Her fuel belongs only to the worthy. Seize the silver, seize the future!

139.name: Forgotten Lands
139.description: Rumors persist of ancient lands, once lost to time, now emerging through the fog...

13.name: Culinary Masters
13.description: Culinary Masters," the incredibly popular cooking competition reality series, is streaming now. Everywhere. On all the platforms. All 1000 episodes from each of the 50 seasons. Even "Culinary Masters Superstars." And "Celebrity Culinary Masters." Start binging today.

140.name: Hearts' Chorus
140.description: Magic lies dormant within every soul. To awaken it again, all it takes is courage, an open mind, and enough conviction to change the world.

14.name: Headhunter
14.description: For some species, the hunt is more than mere sport—it possesses their minds and bodies, molding them into a race of perfect killing machines.

15.name: Guardian of the Sands
15.description: Powerful guardians stand watch over the tomb of an ancient horror, so that it may never threaten the world again. But they may already be too late...

16.name: Sugar Rush
16.description: From the Gingerbread Castle to the Root Beer Sea, the Licorice Mountains to the Gumdrop Forest—this is the Candy Kingdom in all its glory.

17.name: Toy Box
17.description: Gnar's toy chest is brimming with priceless treasures, but when no one's home, his toys take on a life of their own...

19.name: Woad Tribe
19.description: Few can survive a journey through the frozen tundra of the north. If the cold doesn't kill you... the Woad surely will.

1.name: Star Guardian
1.description: In a vast and dark universe, young warriors are chosen by fate to protect the light of the stars. They are destined to burn bright, but collapse as furiously as they shine.

20.name: Moons of Ionia
20.description: A voice echoes from the silence: “Writhe, beasts, brethren. The moons of a doomed Ionia rise like eyes of starved demons, awaiting the red of your fealty—or are they monstrous blights that cannot pass? Either way, we are vessels plunged in ritual and sacrifice. At the moon's peak, we carve flesh from flesh, offering the meager gift of all that we are.”

21.name: Prehistoric Hunters
21.description: Gargantuan monsters roam our land, stalking their prey with frightening precision. Humans would surely become their next meals, if not for the Hunters. Armed with blades crafted from the bones of their first kills, with instincts that rival the most fearsome of beasts, the Hunters protect their people each day from a grisly fate.

22.name: Storybook
22.description: Once upon a time, there was a group of storybook characters brought to life from the page...

23.name: Fables
23.description: Every culture has their own folklore surrounding legends and monsters. Are these myths a figment of our imagination, stories passed down through generations to explain the unexplainable? Or are they based in a truth hidden from the rest of the world?

24.name: Versus
24.description: All things are born from conflict; none can escape it. Harmony is an illusion, and only those who embrace that illusion will reap life's greatest rewards.

25.name: Mecha
25.description: Towering above the city, gargantuan kaiju tussle with towering mechas. Who will win?

26.name: Hextech
26.description: Now at the forefront of science and art, Hextech has evolved from its rudimentary beginnings into a modern renaissance of intricate, artificial lifeforms capable of free will. Skilled artificers lead the medium into a bold new future -- but what it will bring, none can say.

28.name: Snowdown
28.description: Is there a better time of year than Snowdown, when the air is crisp, the snow fluffy, and the chocolate hot? Toss a snowball or sing a carol; as long as you have good cheer, all will be well, and you'll have nothing to fear.

2.name: Warring Kingdoms
2.description: Rival empires vie for power as they attempt to unify the lands, while brave warriors and stoic generals test their skill against the greatest heroes of the era. It is a time of war, and a time of legends.

30.name: Immortal Journey
30.description: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

31.name: High Noon Gothic
31.description: At the height of the industrial revolution, travelers begin pouring into the untamed west, searching for fortune and prosperity among the unknown horrors of a cruel and ancient world. It is a time of brave gunslingers and rotten scoundrels, inscrutable gods, and savage demons.

32.name: Odyssey
32.description: From the urbanized coreworlds to the outermost edge of the galaxy, adventure awaits! The great Demaxian Empire ignores the objections of the Templar Order and the criminal Syndicate alike in their pursuit of ora—a mysterious golden essence that serves as the lifeblood of all civilization, and promises untold power to those who can wield it for themselves…

33.name: PROJECT
33.description: Among the mega-structures and packed streets of a future controlled by global corporations, a shadow war rages between rebellious, augmented humans and newly empowered artificial beings. The winners will shape the course of history... and the losers will be forced to evolve.

34.name: Eclipse
34.description: In the beginning, the Old Gods reigned. So great was humankind's love for them that one dared to make them a part of her flesh forever. She devoured the sun itself and, descending from that empty heaven, inspired her knights to decimate all those that remained. Centuries later, they stand, the only hope against the rising Coven's darkness.

36.name: Mecha Kingdoms
36.description: The Great Kingdoms warred for generations until the arrival of a new enemy. To fight back, they are blessed with gifts from the heavens. Will they rise above their past to save their future?

37.name: Spirit Blossom
37.description: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

38.name: PsyOps
38.description: To protect against rogue forces seeking to destabilize the world, High Command sends PsyOps, an elite team of psychic soldiers. Members include [REDACTED].

3.name: Worldbreaker
3.description: In the end, the moon will smother the sun. And in that hopeless dawn, four titans will rise to shatter the world itself.

40.name: Battle Queens
40.description: Once fractured by endless warfare, the collective Queendoms of Elysia have realized the true nature of their world: that the magic holding their fantastical plane together is maintained only through conflict. They have thus allied through the unifying conflict of the Grand Coronation, though some alliances are beginning to show cracks...

41.name: The Ruined King Saga
41.description: The Black Mist gathers, the Harrowing comes, and the Ruined King has risen once more. Viego's corruption blankets Runeterra, turning friends into foes and bringing entire nations to their knees. The only ones with the power to stop him are the Sentinels of Light: an ancient order led by Senna and Lucian. They must call upon champions from every corner of the realm to fight back the Black Mist and end the Ruined King's reign of terror once and for all.

42.name: Shan Hai Scrolls
42.description: No one can say who created the mysterious Shan Hai Scrolls, or when. All it takes is one glimpse to see the painting is a window to a world of magic and wonder, but perhaps it is more of a doorway?

43.name: Crystal Rose
43.description: In a world of frequently-broken magical alliances and centuries-old grudges, the annual Crystal Rose Festival offers a neutral ground for the powerful to forgive slights and renegotiate truces. Weapons are ostensibly left at the door, and potential new pacts are signaled by picking and wearing the magical roses that grow only during the festival.

45.name: Space Groove
45.description: In a groovy galaxy a million disco infernos away, a mysterious energy known only as The Groove brings music and prosperity to trillions of galactic citizens. But when the alien overlord Lissandra and her army of Harsh Vibes begin to enslave planets and suppress disco music, a new age of heroes rises to stop her, and keep the party grooving.

46.name: Arcana
46.description: High above Arcana, the Archetypes, living patterns that shape reality itself, struggle to trace their vision upon the chaos below them. The Archetypes recruit perceptive citizens of the world below to amplify their hidden patterns—and the more who magnify an Archetype's pattern, the more the world reflects their grand design.

48.name: Crime City Nightmare
48.description: Eldritch horrors lurk within the crime and grime of Valoran City. Black markets have given rise to Elixirs: a valuable substance of dubious origin whose production spells money and influence should any gang corner the market. Spurred on by agents of corruption, capos and cronies alike look to forces beyond the veil for a taste of true power.

4.name: Pulsefire
4.description: Between the branching of infinite realities, Chrono-enforcers clash with fleeing fugitives, temporal warlords, and the unrelenting march of Praetorians through the vicissitudes of space-time.

51.name: Cafe Cuties
51.description: Good food is magic—literally! In a world of elegant tea times and enchanted pastries, mages make magical macarons, craft charmed croissants, and serve up sorcerous scones to scores of customers eager to get a taste.

52.name: Arcane
52.description: In the cities of Piltover and Zaun, unrest stirs as inventors and thieves, politicians and crime lords chafe against the constraints of a society torn asunder. Discovery and danger intertwine as heroes are born and bonds are broken. Will this power change the world, or lead it to ruin?

55.name: Cloudedge
55.description: Bearing weapons imbued with lightning magic through the deadly Cloud Ritual, Shockblades are an order of mysterious shinobi warriors tasked with protecting humankind from malevolent spirits and monsters. They travel between the mortal and spirit realms to chase down threats no one else can touch, safeguarding the future for all denizens of the mortal world.

56.name: AnimaTech
56.description: Humankind is on its last legs, nearly defeated by a high-tech army of deep-sea invaders called the Primordians. Enter Anima Squad: elite fighters using salvaged Primordian tech to push back against the end of the world. To save humanity, they will have to fight like an animal.

58.name: Sunkissed Summer
58.description: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

59.name: Monster Tamers
59.description: Who are we? We're Monster Tamers! We protect the world when it's in danger! When others would flee, we follow the roar. We tame the monster and use the CORE. And with our new friends by our side, we'll hop and run and swim and glide! We'll go anywhere, no matter how far. Because we're Monster Tamers! That's who we are!

5.name: Event Horizon
5.description: In the vast darkness of space are born terrible, beautiful things—Cosmic creatures of sublime love, and the unknowable monstrosities of the Dark Star. These are the children of silent gods, and they are finally coming home.

60.name: Spirit Guard
60.description: Udyr spent almost a decade training in Ionia with the monks of the Hirana Monastery, learning to control and master his spiritual abilities. At last, when the Freljord called him home, he chose to stay and complete his training. In the time since then, Udyr has become part of the Ionian landscape, both spiritual and mortal, as he works with Lee Sin and Karma to return balance to the wartorn land.

61.name: The Grind
61.description: The grind isn't just work. It's the struggle, the hustle, sometimes invigorating, sometimes demoralizing. It's a weeklong rollercoaster with comedic bends and tragic drops, only to start all over again on Monday. Are we working hard or hardly working? It's all the same on the grind.

62.name: Definitely Not
62.description: A totally normal universe with nothing duplicitous, treacherous, or disingenuous going on. Definitely not.

63.name: Iron Firmament
63.description: A war-torn galaxy attempts to rebuild, but old wounds remain. Bounty hunters and corporate agents have filled the power vacuum, some piloting dangerous combat exo suits with godlike abilities. In response, megacorporations leverage private armies to enforce their will across the far-flung colonies of space. War never dies; it only changes battlefields.

64.name: Ages of Runeterra
64.description: Glimpses of selves in other lives. Clashes of fate in another era. Runeterra is a world rich in possibility as its legends find new destinations and destinies.

65.name: Elementalist
65.description: A kingdom hangs on the edge of ruin as an army of titanic elemental beasts wage war on humanity. The last line of defense is held by a lone warrior queen, Elementalist Lux. To save her people, she must look within and reveal her true nature... no matter what form it takes.

66.name: Infernal
66.description: Fire, sulfur, and death. There is no returning to what the world was before the Ashen Lord rose. It is a dream, lost to the searing lava rivers beneath volcano-strewn lands. Now a new age begins, one that will burn for eternity.

67.name: Legacy
67.description: Treasures from days long passed, glimmering just within reach.

68.name: Wonders of the World
68.description: Individuals hailing from the far-flung universe of "Earth," where giant statues come to life and everyone is wearing a fun hat. It's a lot like Runeterra, if you think about it.

69.name: Institute of War
69.description: Though the rigid laws, empires, and political turmoil that lead to the Rune War have since faded into antiquity, the tales of legendary battles fought on the Fields of Justice are kept alive by the remnants of the Magelords and Protectorate. The Marauders and Wardens continue their ancestors' legacy of war and animosity, despite how removed they are from those initial conflicts.

6.name: Dragon World
6.description: Twice did dragonfire consume the world. Twice from the embers were heroes forged.

70.name: Kinetex Machina
70.description: It's the 22nd century; body augmentation is a common part of society. Humanity's limits change constantly, creating an unheard of sense of optimism and possibility. Every four years, nations put aside their conflicts in the spirit of harmony and competition in the Zenith Games. They enter not to show the world what's possible, but what it might become.

71.name: Arcade
71.description: Insert Coin to Play" flashes on the screen, an irrestistable offer for any gamer worth their salt. But whisked away from their humble arcade into a world of Heroes and Battle Bosses, these ordinary players will have to fight with all the reflexes and combos they can muster. Because gamers in Arcadia... are playing with their lives.

72.name: Tales from the Rift
72.description: Parents tell their children stories of wicked witches and the like, those that lurk the streets one night each year. "Stay in your bed, little one, for darkness is their friend." These tales are only partly true; while the ghouls of this enchanted evening love a good scare, they'd never harm a hair on a child's head. Except for the very naughty ones.

73.name: Bees
73.description: Bzzz. Bzzz bzzz bzzz. Bzzz! Bzzz, bzz, bzz bzz bzz. Bzzz...

74.name: Silver Age
74.description: The rift's greatest superheroes and most dastardly villains, available at a comic store near you!

75.name: Cats Versus Dogs
75.description: The oldest rivalry the world has ever known: man's best friend pitted against the internet's greatest heroes. Only one faction will emerge victorious from the gnawing maw of battle between cats and dogs. Hopefully they don't get their fur too dirty: the only thing worse than losing is bathtime.

76.name: Neighborhood Nightmare
76.description: Terrifying tales of oddball outsiders, fiendish friends, and ghoulish gatherings.

77.name: Ye Olde
77.description: Life is a blessing within the castle walls of Lord Tryndamere's domain. Knights may seek out the blacksmith to purchase their wares or one of many mages for sage advice. And for the adventurous in spirit, the lands of Albion await, their mysteries known only to the fae folk that reside there.

78.name: Dark Waters
78.description: Bilgewater, where death is swifter than the currents, and the rules as formless as swill. Where coin is the one key that can unlock anything, and the truth is only a lie agreed upon.

79.name: Riot Records
79.description: Sure, it's about sold out stadiums, the high-fashion swagger, the cheering crowd; but it's also about speakers cranked so loud, your ears ring like they want to sing along. About hot stage lights, pounding bass, and the steady rhythm of the drums. It's about that adrenaline high, igniting you from the inside out. This feeling? This is music.

80.name: Victorious
80.description: Champions conquer their enemies and ascend to new heights, achieving their wildest dreams and showing off their hard-earned spoils to any and all who want to look upon true greatness.

81.name: Honor
81.description: Society has become increasingly individualistic and closed off under the Essent's rule. People are encouraged to care only about themselves, so nobody trusts each other. As leader of the long-dead Order of Solace, Malzahar seeks to bring harmony to this dissonant world through the uplifting aura of Solace. He knows that only by coming together can they inspire a better world.

82.name: Heavy Metal
82.description: Audiences gather from all over the world for a chance to witness the greatest robot fighters throw down in RiotCorp's gladiatorial arenas, eager for the chance to be crowned the Full Metal Robot Fighting League Champion or break down trying.

84.name: Academy
84.description: ATTENTION STUDENTS AND FACULTY: It has come to our attention that all students are currently facing disiplinary action and all professors are on "suggested" psychiatric leave. Class will be canceled until further notice, perhaps a time when the aformentioned suspeded students have reexamined their abysmal behavior.

85.name: Arcanists
85.description: Right outside the academy doors is a world filled with magic... and danger. The professors caution the young wizards and witches to stay within the safety of the school grounds, grow their power, and study well—but where is the fun in that when adventure awaits just beyond the bend?

86.name: Star Voyagers
86.description: It's dangerous to traverse space alone… take a meep! Unless it's purple. The purple ones are evil.

87.name: God Weapon
87.description: Scattered across the globe, the God Weapons morphed society into one driven by power. These sentient monuments call to those who are worthy and bestow their gifts upon their subjects, aiming to expand their conquest in this war-torn world. To be chosen is a badge of honor, instilling fear into any who may oppose them.

89.name: Blackfrost
89.description: The Ice Witch lets none slumber; each fallen friend and foe in her domain rises anew to fight by her side. Her dark magic twists their appearance, creating glacial golems with hearts of black, unmelting ice.

90.name: Bloodstone
90.description: The fabled Bloodstone grants impressive abilities at an equally chilling price. Many bodies lie in its wake, with doubtless more to come, because there is no shortage of power within the darkness, only the will to seize it.

91.name: Esports
91.description: Some say holding up the Summoner's Cup before a stadium of cheering fans is the greatest prize... others say it's the cash. The folks who make Skins on the League of Legends team? We think that the best part of winning Worlds is being immortalized in your favorite game. And we aren't biased!

92.name: Collector Edition
92.description: For the discerning collector of limited edition MOBA releases in 2009.

93.name: War is Heck
93.description: What is this?! We're in war, soldier, and you're spending your time reading? What use is reading when you're scooching your skinny butt through rat-infested mud in the middle of a hurricane under live fire? None, that's what! Now get in formation!

94.name: Cottontail
94.description: It's rabbit season! Fine folk up and down the bunny trail are dressed in their bun-day best, eggs painted and smiles wide. Here's hoping their hopping helps you with holiday cheer!

95.name: Crimson Elite
95.description: How does one find the Crimson Elite? Follow the bodies.

96.name: Death Sworn
96.description: The underworld stirs with ominous activity. Death marshals its subjects for a new plan of terrifying design, one that will require the souls of every mortal.

97.name: Demonic
97.description: To those poor souls condemned to suffering, whether bound by contract or practiced wickedness, the eternal fires of Hell will be waiting.

98.name: Four Beasts
98.description: Divine beasts watch over the world entire, capable of turning anyone into powerful beings, but only if that soul is worthy of their blessings. Whether their power is used for good or evil, once the gift is given, it cannot be taken away.

99.name: Dreadknights
99.description: Brought back to life by mysterious ancient magic, these undead knights are the only remnants of a storied history, lost to time. They'll protect what once was theirs, at any cost to mortal life.

9.name: Riftquest
9.description: Danger lurks in the land of Runeterra! Powerful monsters, dastardly sorcerers, and mythical creatures roam unchecked! Gather your friends and create your own adventure for 3-5 players, vanquishing evil with each roll of the die. Do you have what it takes to save the world, and become a legend of RIFTQUEST?

1.name: World Champions: 2011
1.description: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2011: Fnatic!

2.name: World Champions: 2012
2.description: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2012: Taipei Assassins!

3.name: World Champions: 2013
3.description: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2013: SK Telecom T1!

4.name: World Champions: 2014
4.description: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2014: Samsung White!

5.name: World Champions: 2015
5.description: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2015: SK Telecom T1!

6.name: World Champions: 2016
6.description: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2016: SK Telecom T1!

7.name: Victorious
7.description: Champions conquer their enemies and ascend to new heights, achieving their wildest dreams and showing off their hard-earned spoils to any and all who want to look upon true greatness.

8.name: World Championship
8.description: The greatest stage in all of gaming. Two teams face off before millions of fans. Only one will be crowned the champion.

9.name: Challenger
9.description: Commemorating the annual League of Legends season start.

10.name: Arcade: Heroes
10.description: Arcadia: home to the server's most competitive arcade gamers and justice-driven NPCs. Here, the heroes always play to win. And that means overriding the Battle Bosses' corrupted code, even with the odds stacked against them. Victory won't come easy, but seeing the surprise on the bosses' faces after an incredible outplay will totally make it worth it.

11.name: Arcade: Battle Bosses
11.description: Deep within Arcadia's servers lies a sinister series of glitches known to all gamers as the Battle Bosses. Their corrupted code has brought them newfound freedom… but also new challengers. To complete their deletion of the Arcade World, many of the Bosses have agreed to put aside their differences (until it's… inconvenient).

12.name: Blood Moon
12.description: An ancient cult, seeking irresistible power, surfaces on nights of the Blood Moon to perform profane, esoteric rites—merging their flesh with demonic spirits, and becoming one with an ever greater darkness.

13.name: Dragon World
13.description: Twice did dragonfire consume the world. Twice from the embers were heroes forged.

14.name: Omega Squad
14.description: When the war came, Omega Squad was sent to end it. Now only one of them remains, a yordle with no battles left to fight but his own...

15.name: Pool Party
15.description: It's summer, baby! The sun's out, the breeze's warm, and the water's cool. Everybody's leaving their rivalries and grudges at home, and bringing only swimsuits and good vibes. There'll be plenty of time for punching and yelling later. Just sit back, enjoy the music, and soak up the fun.

16.name: Pentakill
16.description: In a world where heavy metal reigns supreme, PENTAKILL are the undisputed masters of melting the face right off your head. Six members, two penta-platinum albums, and the chrome-fisted fury of the gods themselves. It's time to rock!

17.name: Program
17.description: An advanced security algorithm created by the PROJECT Corporation, the Program quietly evolved sentience before altering its original directive. Infecting machines across The City, it has determined that the ultimate threat to humanity's safety... is humanity itself.

18.name: PROJECT
18.description: The PROJECT Corporation believes unlocking the secrets of humanity's potential is the key to progress beyond our mortal bodies. It is through technology that we will ascend. Together.

19.name: Star Guardian Season 1
19.description: Magically empowered by the First Star, high schooler Lux and her team of Star Guardians secretly protect the world from interstellar monsters. But who will protect them from the drama of Valoran City High?

20.name: Star Guardian Season 2
20.description: Veteran Star Guardians Ahri and Miss Fortune suddenly reappear in Valoran City, having rebuilt their team after an unknown event destroyed their previous squad. Seeking to defy the destiny of every Star Guardian who takes up the oath, they join the fight alongside Lux and company as Void Beasts descend upon the city.

21.name: Super Galaxy
21.description: Space, the most dangerous frontier! Only the Super Galaxy Defense Force, with its seemingly endless supply of fresh academy recruits, is prepared to explore the farthest uncharted worlds and defend from the most ruthless alien threats. Best gig in the galaxy!

22.name: Academy
22.description: ATTENTION STUDENTS AND FACULTY: It has come to our attention that all students are currently facing disiplinary action and all professors are on "suggested" psychiatric leave. Class will be canceled until further notice, perhaps a time when the aformentioned suspeded students have reexamined their abysmal behavior.

23.name: Debonair
23.description: Power, wealth, and glamour collide in the penthouses and exclusive clubs of Nox Vegas, where truly beautiful people hold the world in their palms. Yet as night falls on the city of lights, the knives come out—influence is the name of the game, and nobody likes to lose.

24.name: Arclight
24.description: Once each millenium an ancient, godlike entity descends from the heavens, choosing worthy warriors to be his will incarnate. These beings are the Arclight—immortal agents of the light divine.

27.name: Vandal
27.description: The Vandals loom large over the wasteland. They are a gang of violent thugs prone to mass destruction, brutal beatdowns, and wanton murder… but they sure have a good time doing it.

28.name: Winter Sports
28.description: When the winter sports festival in question relaxed its rules, many assumed the event would become more exciting. But few realized just how dangerous it would become. Dangerously exciting that is!

29.name: Worldbreaker
29.description: The Prophecy of the First Destruction warned of four titans hellbent on devastation, a tale that would surely come to pass. And in its wake, the Worldweaver grew from ashen soil and built the broken earth anew. Only the wisest of seers see the story yet to come, a second coming and a last hope.

30.name: Headhunter
30.description: For some species, the hunt is more than mere sport—it possesses their minds and bodies, molding them into a race of perfect killing machines.

31.name: Soccer Cup
31.description: Forget the battlefield, the boardroom, or even the playground: the most important conflicts of today are settled on the pitch. There is no act as satisfying as watching your favorite player slip through the other team, line up their shot, deliver that fateful kick, and release the sweetest word in existence: “GOOOOOAAAAALLLLL!”

32.name: Prehistoric Hunters
32.description: Gargantuan monsters roam our land, stalking their prey with frightening precision. Humans would surely become their next meals, if not for the Hunters. Armed with blades crafted from the bones of their first kills, with instincts that rival the most fearsome of beasts, the Hunters protect their people each day from a grisly fate.

33.name: Justicar
33.description: Standing tall within the Agents of Light are the Justicars, sentinels of the Arclight exemplifying its strongest virtues. It is not enough to serve as an example for only mortals, for even divine soldiers need inspiration.

34.name: Luchador
34.description: From the top rope comes the greatest show in sports entertainment! Watch as El Tigre, El Macho, El León, and El Rayo trade bumps and high-flying spots inside AND outside the squared circle. Just remember, nobody does it better than the Wrestling Federation of Valoran.

35.name: Mecha
35.description: When colossal kaiju begin attacking from the sea, land, and air, humanity develops equally powerful mecha units to stop them in explosive hand-to-hand combat.

36.name: Pulsefire
36.description: After unlocking the secrets of time travel, these champions are thrust into a far-flung dystopian future. While Chrono-enforcers relentlessly pursue them across time and space, a small few have escaped into history—taking their technology along for the ride.

37.name: Riot
37.description: In the criminal justice system, there are those who bend the law and those who break it. The dedicated officers at the RPD investigate the city's most heinous crimes to bring the worst offenders to justice. These are their stories...

38.name: Rift Quest
38.description: Danger lurks in the land of Runeterra! Powerful monsters, dastardly sorcerers, and mythical creatures roam unchecked! Gather your friends and create your own adventure for 3-5 players, vanquishing evil with each roll of the die. Do you have what it takes to save the world, and become a legend of RIFTQUEST?

39.name: High Noon
39.description: Gunslingers and lawmen ride beneath the merciless sun of the high frontier, chasing survival and salvation in equal measure. Heaven is rubble, hell is empty, and all the devils are here.

40.name: Hextech
40.description: Now at the forefront of science and art, Hextech has evolved from its rudimentary beginnings into a modern renaissance of intricate, artificial lifeforms capable of free will. Skilled artificers lead the medium into a bold new future -- but what it will bring, none can say.

41.name: Highstakes
41.description:
Once, there were five, a strange group indeed,
That made up the court of High Stakes.
They bickered and fought, had luck and had not,
To this day, no one yet knows their fate.

42.name: Piltover Customs
42.description: Looking for a souped-up ride? Look no further. (Mileage may vary.)

43.name: Cosmic
43.description: Vast stardust creatures control the ebb and flow of creation, painting the cosmos with sublime light as their celestial court drifts along the fabric of time and space.

44.name: Dark Star
44.description: Entropy engulfs galaxies in the yawning maw of the Dark Star, whose corruptants, titanic creatures of black-hole oblivion, snuff out the light of existence in every system they touch and plunge them into nothingness.

45.name: Marauder
45.description: A horde of nomadic warriors with a taste for brutality, the Marauders are all that remain of Magelord warrior culture, their ancient traditions abandoned in favor of anarchic shows of force. No dispute is settled until blood is spilled, even within their own ranks. They lost sight of what led their ancestors to war in the first place and what ultimately led to their victory.

46.name: Snow Day
46.description: It's beginning to look a lot like Snow Day, up and down the lanes... \nThough your tank may be rushing in, Top is backing again, \nThey have gold to spend on a Lich Bane...

47.name: Winter Wonder
47.description: Within the magical Winterlands, the Poro King reigns supreme, spreading joy and merriment to all of his court. Even as others work to usurp the king, all share a common love for winter's wonders.

48.name: Snowdown Showdown
48.description: Better start building that snow fort...

49.name: Bilgewater: Burning Tides
49.description: Welcome to Bilgewater, where fortunes're made at the end of a gun. Anything y'might need can be found at the slaughter docks, whether that be some hired hands, sea monster stew, or the captain who will send you to your watery grave.

50.name: Warden
50.description: The Protectorate was an order dedicated to enforcing a rigid, unforgiving system of laws, in an attempt to slow the seemingly inevitable rise of the Magelords. Though the order itself was disbanded long ago, Wardens now don their armor as they lie in wait for the opportunity to strike against the descendants of their ancient enemy.

51.name: Crime City
51.description: Valoran City, a sprawling machine fueled by crime and oiled by sordid money. No one admits this truth, but everyone knows it.

52.name: Thunder Lord
52.description: Mankind are not the only ones who fight bitter wars over petty squabbles. Once, before our time, two gods—two brothers—took up arms against each other, shaping the very land with the desolation of their battle.

53.name: Lunar Revel: Warring Kingdoms
53.description: Three great empires vie for land and power, bringing their all to bear in a test of martial might. Armies will clash. Heroes will rise. Legends will be made.

54.name: Lunar Revel: Firecracker
54.description: The Lunar New Year has arrived—and so has the party! With food and festivities to spare, it's all about ringing it in with friends and family. Now strike up a match and watch the fireworks!

55.name: Lunar Revel
55.description: Join with friends and frenemies alike and celebrate the stories of the past year. Glowing lanterns touch the night sky, lit by fading fireworks. Red envelopes trade hands, families and clans that rarely meet rejoice in a shared acknowledgement: a new year beckons. May it be your best one yet!

56.name: Cottontail
56.description: It's rabbit season! Fine folk up and down the bunny trail are dressed in their bun-day best, eggs painted and smiles wide. Here's hoping their hopping helps you with holiday cheer!

57.name: Sugar Rush
57.description: From the Gingerbread Castle to the Root Beer Sea, the Licorice Mountains to the Gumdrop Forest—this is the Candy Kingdom in all its glory.

58.name: Elderwood
58.description: Deep within the Elderwood, ancient beings lie in wait, hidden from man. They protect the enchanted forest, punishing trespassers and inspiring tales across the land. However, as horrors of the outside world spread, the defenders struggle to maintain their strongholds against humanity's malicious curiosity.

59.name: Eternum
59.description: In the hollow space between far-off stars, organic machines made by an unknown civilization have long since outlived their creators. They patiently lurk, unable to escape their terrestrial prison until someone stumbles upon them once more and unleashes them back out into the galaxy. They have waited. They are waiting. They will wait—as long as it takes.

60.name: Order of the Lotus
60.description: Esteemed leaders and devoted acolytes in the Order of the Lotus are the finest of the First Lands. Avatars of immortality and virtue, members of the Order live many lifetimes, striving to keep peace eternal.

61.name: Toy Box
61.description: Gnar's toy chest is brimming with priceless treasures, but when no one's home, his toys take on a life of their own...

62.name: Death Blossom
62.description: The sylvan creatures of the northern forests lie dormant, unseen by weary traveler and brave warrior alike. These foul things wait for the perfect moment to strike, an exercise in patience passed only by creatures as ancient as the land itself, the prize a feast of flesh and bone that bathes the soil in dark, rich crimson.

63.name: arcticops
63.description: High Command needed a new group to handle the growing threats along the Arctic Front. They needed soldiers colder than the glaciers they'd be crossing, with ice in their veins and frosty nerves. Enter Arctic Ops.

64.name: Heartbreakers
64.description: Most seek out sweethearts in quiet parks or friendly tea shops. But those relationships never last. The bonds formed on the battlefield, piercing like bullets straight through the hearts of enemies... those endure.

65.name: Steel Valkyries
65.description: A galaxy scarred by war now attempts to rebuild, but the old wounds remain. Criminals, bounty hunters, mercenaries, and assassins have filled the power vacuum, piloting dangerous combat exo-suits with godlike abilities.

66.name: Guardian of the Sands
66.description: Powerful guardians stand watch over the tomb of an ancient horror, so that it may never threaten the world again. But they may already be too late...

67.name: Pharaoh
67.description: Though their empires were swallowed by the sands, mighty Pharaohs once ruled the sun-baked dunes of the Great Desert.

68.name: Woad
68.description: Few can survive a journey through the frozen tundra of the north. If the cold doesn't kill you... the Woad surely will.

69.name: Lancer
69.description: With the times growing dire, the great mechanized Lancers of old rouse from their slumber. Taller than any building and more powerful than any army, they rise to protect their subjects before returning to the earth once more.

70.name: Road Warrior
70.description: Out in the wasteland, the only gospel a Road Warrior needs is the hum of an engine, and the only prayers they hear are the curses of their enemies.

71.name: Storybook
71.description: Once upon a time, there was a group of storybook characters brought to life from the page...

72.name: Fables
72.description: Every culture has their own folklore surrounding legends and monsters. Are these myths a figment of our imagination, stories passed down through generations to explain the unexplainable? Or are they based in a truth hidden from the rest of the world?

73.name: Odyssey
73.description: From the urbanized coreworlds to the outermost edge of the galaxy, adventure awaits! The great Demaxian Empire ignores the objections of the Templar Order and the criminal Syndicate alike in their pursuit of ora—a mysterious golden essence that serves as the lifeblood of all civilization, and promises untold power to those who can wield it for themselves…

74.name: Bilgewater: Curse of the Drowned
74.description: 'Neath waxing moon and rising tides, dark magicks stir and secrets hide. Where salt and blood and fell winds flow… as above the waves, so too below.

75.name: World Champions: 2017
75.description: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2017: Samsung Galaxy!

76.name: Dreadnova
76.description: A criminal network of ruthless mercenaries who rule entire swaths of the galaxy, Dreadnova has grown powerful since its founders fled Genesis Industries' ranks with stolen exosuit plans in tow. Now they push back against the Royal Space Military's efforts to impose Genesis' corporate order, bringing to bear all the firepower the black market has to offer.

78.name: Battle of the God-Kings
78.description: At the end of a dark timeline, two kings descended from the primordial gods of Order and Chaos lead vast armies in one final clash.

79.name: Kaiju
79.description: From the depths of the planet, they rise: colossal entities of horror and hunger, mightier than armies and mountains. Their motivations are uncertain; their designs, unknown. The one thing that is clear is that we will not survive them... unless we create the means to stop them.

80.name: Omen of the Dark
80.description: This story of a cursed queen and the wretched followers of her order makes unpleasant bedside banter for parents and their children. But lessons last longer when the tale is gripped in shadow, which swirls in dreams and shapes the souls of impressionable youth. The nightmares are just nightmares, after all... or so the adults pray.

81.name: Immortal Journey
81.description: Long ago, in an ancient land, many souls gathered beneath the gods to test the limits of their power. Foolish and arrogant, brave and just, their journeys are written into the immortal pages of history…

82.name: Traditional
82.description: Honoring the initial designs of reworked champions.

83.name: Collector's Edition
83.description: Everything feels better when it comes inside a Collector's Edition box, be it digital or physical.

84.name: PAX
84.description: PAX: the intersection of all things gaming, where play is celebrated and immortal bonds are formed.

85.name: Steel Legion
85.description: In the shadow of all-out warfare between Genesis Industries and Dreadnova, ruined lives are just collateral damage. The Steel Legion is a vigilante organization operated out of run-down battleground planets, founded by refugees and armed by weapons crafted from scraps of rubble. If no one else will defend them, the people must defend themselves.

86.name: Infernal
86.description: Scorching an entire world takes unimaginable strength, which is why the Ashen Lord called upon his legions of Infernals to lend their flames. From the darkest depths, they each bring their own terrible powers to bear, though not all answer their call with the same burning enthusiasm.

87.name: Death Sworn
87.description: Eager to claim more souls for the underworld, Death sends the souls of fallen warriors as Death Sworn back to the mortal plane, where they serve their master's terrible bidding with relish.

88.name: Trick-or-Treat
88.description: You better hope you have the good stuff. You know, Piltover Pops, Strikebreaker Sours, Dark Star Chocolate Bars... 'Cause if you don't, the kids on this block have some tricks up their sleeves.

90.name: Praetorian
90.description: Nothing is safe from the cold clutches of the Praetorians, a mechanical plague tearing through spacetime. For as hard as the Remembrancers fight to stave off the eradication of all life, deep down they are filled with fear, knowing that at some point they'll tire, while the Praetorians never will.

91.name: K/DA
91.description: “There is a place between fantasy and reality where anything can happen. You have the power to be anyone, and do anything. It is your dream. In our in-between world, K/DA feels confident and strong. We can do anything, and so can you.” -Kai'Sa

92.name: Coven
92.description: The witches lay in wait, a sisterhood of frightening pulchritude, their hopes whispered forth from desacralized lips. They speak of the bloating corpses of Old Gods, of ancient rites carried out with magics long forgotten to mortal mind, of the return of what they call "order", but others call "suffering". Hark! Mankind's end fast approaches.

93.name: Eclipse
93.description: Long ago, an order of monastic knights slew the vile gods of the old world, using esoteric powers granted by the moon and sun. Now the world has grown dark and violent, as those selfsame deities prepare their return—challenged only by the light of the eclipse.

94.name: Astronauts
94.description: Astronauts, hijinks, and adorable alien meeps! Defying gravity is just another day for these adventurous space protectors, as they defend planet M33p and traverse the grand cosmos that awaits them.

95.name: Arcanists
95.description: Right outside the academy doors is a world filled with magic... and danger. The professors caution the young wizards and witches to stay within the safety of the school grounds, grow their power, and study well—but where is the fun in that when adventure awaits just beyond the bend?

96.name: Papercraft
96.description: Do you see a saddle on my back?" chirped the phoenix. "I am no pack-bird. And that yeti will weigh down our flight." The boy looked on, his perfect plan rejected. But then, a smile creased his face. After all, in this world of folded foliage and crinkled creeks, adventure is always just beyond the bend.

97.name: Albion
97.description: Once the dominion of fallen Elven empires, the vast forests of Albion are now home to kingdoms and brigands and elves and free men in equal measure. There's power to be found in the imperial ruins, should anyone be bold enough to venture deep into the woods to seek it…

98.name: Cats Versus Dogs
98.description: The oldest rivalry the world has ever known: man's best friend pitted against the internet's greatest heroes. Only one faction will emerge victorious from the gnawing maw of battle between cats and dogs. Hopefully they don't get their fur too dirty: the only thing worse than losing is bathtime.

99.name: Wonders of the World
99.description: Individuals hailing from the far-flung universe of "Earth," where giant statues come to life and everyone is wearing a fun hat. It's a lot like Runeterra, if you think about it.

101.name: Definitely Not
101.description: Is that a robot in glasses and a trenchcoat? Of course not. Do your eyes perceive a beast man in a onesie? Better get those eyes checked, because they're wrong. Isn't Draven too modest to wear his own head? How foolish you must feel to even ask. And that laser squid? Definitely human. Definitely.

102.name: High Society
102.description: The only thing more impressive than their wealth is their tax avoidance skills.

103.name: Dunkmaster
103.description: There are two types of people in this world: those that dunk, and those who get dunked. If you don't know which one you are, then watch out! 'Cuz you're about to GET DUNKED!

104.name: Commando
104.description: Just your average bottomless pit of scum and villainy. Bosses vie for power; pacts are made and broken; friendships meet their end on the edge of twisted, subtle knives. And yet, there's something more to this city. Something undiscovered, imperceptible. Something... infinite.

105.name: Invaders
105.description: True to their title, these nefarious alien meeps have stumbled upon a power they don't quite understand. Unfortunately, misery loves company. Those who come into contact with the invaders almost always come out on the other side just a little more evil… and purple!

106.name: Mad Scientists
106.description: The job requirements are pretty simple: we're looking for at least five years of experience in applied sciences, your last peer-reviewed paper, and two references. Oh, and an evil laugh. Actually, put that at the top of the list.

107.name: World Champions: 2018
107.description: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2018: Invictus Gaming!

108.name: Forgotten Depths
108.description: Sit down, my child, and listen close. The ocean is a wonder, the foaming waves that reach our peaceful shores a deceitful invitation. For what lies beneath that endless blue is a world beyond our imagining. Of kingdoms ruined and monsters fierce, floating down in those forgotten depths.

109.name: Conqueror
109.description: Commemorating the League of Legends Mid-Season Invitational and Spring Split tournaments.

111.name: Silver Age
111.description: The rift's greatest superheroes and most dastardly villains, available at a comic store near you!

112.name: Glacial
112.description: The world is frozen, with few left to remember its cause. Old terrors stir from beneath the ice, ready to claim the world once more. The flame of hope remains, but the days are short, and the nights long…

113.name: Battle Academia
113.description: At these institutions, only the strong survive. Though they were founded to honor their God Weapon, the students at each academy strive to make its strength their own on their path to glory. Whether it's the classroom, or the battlefield, dominate the competition.

114.name: Medieval
114.description: Hark, ye knights and knaves, for these lands are under the royal protection of the King and Queen! Make way, make way!

115.name: Rift Hospital
115.description: Take a seat. The doctor will be right with you.

116.name: Demonic
116.description: Even in the kingdom of Hell, fervent personalities jockey for higher standing, gambling with the souls of mortals in their power plays for the dark lord's favor.

117.name: Demacia Vice
117.description: As Ahri locks in her character on the start screen, the synth-heavy score fills the arcade. Her button taps aren't random, but perfectly calculated as she guides her champ through the crime-filled Demacian streets. A crowd gathers, intent on watching Ahri finally beat the high score, set by her only days ago.

118.name: Heavy Metal
118.description: Audiences gather from all over the world for a chance to witness the greatest robot fighters throw down in RiotCorp's gladiatorial arenas, eager for the chance to be crowned the Full Metal Robot Fighting League Champion or break down trying.

119.name: Star Guardian Season 3
119.description: Ahri's old squad resurfaces, changed from the events that once tore them apart... and followed by a threat beyond anything the Star Guardians have ever faced. Can the group move past old grudges and save themselves from annihilation? Or will they simply be the next victims of the Twilight Star?

120.name: True Damage
120.description: “What is True Damage? Man, True Damage is the future! It's a collective of the best artists from around the world, coming together with the best collaboration, to make the best hip-hop music. We're five steps ahead of the game. Everyone else has gotta catch up.” -Ekko

121.name: Cops and Robbers
121.description: Nobody puts in the work like the Piltover Police Department. Who else can lock up the most sugar-laden donuts inside their merciless stomachs, rack up the highest of overtimes, and ignore even the most menial of paperwork? The criminals may be taking advantage of it, but even they wish they had the same work ethic.

122.name: Crimson Elite
122.description: We can neither confirm nor deny the Crimson Elite's involvement in any criminal activities and request all inquiries be directed to local authorities.

123.name: Dreadknights
123.description: Brought back to life by mysterious ancient magic, these undead knights are the only remnants of a storied history, lost to time. They'll protect what once was theirs, at any cost to mortal life.

124.name: Dawnbringer
124.description: Order and light reign through deities of dawn, bringing structure to a nascent world locked in conflict with the forces of night.

125.name: Nightbringer
125.description: Chaos and darkness reign through deities of night, bringing change to a static world locked in conflict with the forces of dawn.

126.name: Bloodstone
126.description: Terrors abound in the depths of night, with none as fearsome as the Bloodstone cults. Shrieks fill the air in their presence, while the streets run red, for their master hungers and must be satiated.

127.name: Mecha Kingdoms
127.description: The Great Kingdoms warred for generations until the arrival of a new enemy. To fight back, they are blessed with gifts from the heavens. Will they rise above their past to save their future?

128.name: Freljord
128.description: The harsh, frozen north rarely sees travelers from other lands. Those that brave its wilds are met with hostile nature and unwelcoming hordes. Lucky are the few that survive to return to the nation they call home.

129.name: Blackfrost
129.description: The Ice Witch lets none slumber; each fallen friend and foe in her domain rises anew to fight by her side. Her dark magic twists their appearance, creating glacial golems with hearts of black, unmelting ice.

130.name: World Champions: 2019
130.description: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2019: FunPlus Phoenix!

133.name: PsyOps
133.description: The crown jewel of military black ops, the PsyOps unit are an elite team of psychic soldiers deployed against rogue militaries and supernatural threats. Officially, they don't exist. But when conventional warfare won't cut it and the stakes are no less than the fate of the world, PsyOps answers the call.

134.name: Black Rose Group
134.description: A psychic paramilitary unit of fearsome power, the Black Rose Group hopes to create a new global order with their ferocious human bioweapons.

135.name: Dragonmancers
135.description: Majestic dragons dwell in remote places of wild beauty, avoiding mortal affairs outside of rarely bestowing their gifts on only a select few. The Dragonmancers are those fortunate and powerful enough to have gained the ultimate blessing. Whether they then use that for good or for evil is up to them, and anyone strong enough to stop them.

136.name: Galactic
136.description: The War of the Broken Moon has ravaged our galaxy for near a hundred cycles. And still... there is no end in sight.

138.name: Ruined
138.description: The Harrowing spreads its Black Mist across Runeterra, corrupting indiscriminately. Some, in its presence, are swayed to follow the Ruined King, believing their goals aligned. But Viego wants only the return of Isolde; he has no allies. The Ruined who aid him in halting the Sentinels are mere pawns in a broken-hearted lover's game.

139.name: Shan Hai Scrolls
139.description: Within the fabled Shan Hai Scrolls, gods and mythical creatures roam magical lands, wielding the power of the elements. Some are content to live with the palette they've been given, while others wish to jump beyond the borders and paint their lives with a new brush.

140.name: Crystal Rose
140.description: Romance and joy are in the air at the yearly Crystal Rose Festival, where adversaries meet on peaceful, neutral ground to share a night of dancing, merriment, and making wishes for the future. Everyone is expected to leave their weapons at the door as a promise for a better tomorrow.

141.name: Withered Rose
141.description: The Crystal Rose Festival welcomes all who believe in its dream of a peaceful tomorrow, though many have grown disenchanted with the whole affair. Those who make up the Withered Rose wish to see it come to an end. But no one is immune to the festival's charm; perhaps they too will be swept away by the evening's beauty and have a change of heart.

142.name: Lunar Beast
142.description: Each year, a mischievous Lunar Beast arrives in the mortal realm, drawn to the New Year's celebrations. And each year, the corresponding Lunar God selects a squad of chosen champions to lead the beast on a merry chase and protect the city from the creature's playful rampage. The Lunar Parade is a beloved part of the New Year's festivities and the Beast itself brings good luck once it's been lulled to rest by the squad's efforts. When a Lunar Beast is well-entertained and well-rested, it always signals a prosperous New Year!

143.name: Bees!
143.description: Bzzz. Bzzz bzzz bzzz. Bzzz! Bzzz, bzz, bzz bzz bzz. Bzzz...

144.name: Space Groove
144.description: In a groovy galaxy a million disco infernos away, a mysterious energy known only as The Groove brings music and prosperity to trillions of galactic citizens. But when the alien overlord Lissandra and her army of Harsh Vibes begin to enslave planets and suppress disco music, a new age of heroes rises to stop her, and keep the party grooving.

145.name: World Champions: 2020
145.description: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2020: DAMWON Gaming!

147.name: Sentinels of Light
147.description: Though their numbers are few, the Sentinels of Light share a storied history. For years they've fought back the Harrowing, aided by ancient relic-stone weaponry that channels their very souls into a powerful light. But all that matters now is the battle ahead, as the Ruined King lays waste to Runeterra, all to dance with his queen once more.

148.name: Cyber Pop
148.description: In the vibrant underground of Sound City, hackers, skaters, rebels, and rogues band together away from the prying eyes of powerful cyber-corporate overlords.

149.name: Crime City Nightmare
149.description: If corruption and illegality existed on a map, Valoran City would be its center. A breeding ground for all things depraved, there are no depths too deep from which evil can be found, and the horrors that lurk there are eager to spread their influence.

150.name: Phoenixmancers
150.description: Only the truest hearts are blessed by the divine fenghuang, a legendary phoenix who watches over the world. Her champions receive a single feather—each one containing unimaginable elemental power, granting them the means needed to protect all that is innocent and good from forces lurking in the shadows.

151.name: Pentakill III: The Lost Chapter
151.description: In a realm consecrated to dark and uncaring gods, where mortals clash in ceaseless, bloody sagas of metal, one band rose above all others: Pentakill, chosen of the Noisome Host. Now revered in temples and arenas across the land, their supremacy has become absolute—though a time of change is approaching, and the cycle may soon begin anew...

154.name: Porcelain
154.description: In a world where ancient spirits and magical creatures thrive in the periphery of modern society, powerful porcelain artifacts called the Zodiac Relics are key to unlocking immense power. They are kept safe by the Protectors: immortal guardians tasked with keeping the Relics out of the wrong hands.

155.name: Shockblade
155.description: Bearing weapons imbued with lightning magic through the deadly Cloud Ritual, Shockblades are an order of mysterious shinobi warriors tasked with protecting humankind from malevolent spirits and monsters. They travel between the mortal and spirit realms to chase down threats no one else can touch, safeguarding the future for all denizens of the mortal world.

157.name: Ashen Knights
157.description: Many ages long past, a great king waged a glorious war: to break the shackles of magic on the world, so that mankind could forge its own destiny. Yet upon severing the final font of enchantment, the king was lost, the foundations of the world crumbled, and his once-legendary knights were left alone to madness, ruin, and ash.

158.name: World Champions: 2021
158.description: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2021: Edward Gaming!

159.name: Ocean Song
159.description: Nothing exudes the "beach vibes and cool tunes" lifestyle more than the Ocean Song Festival. From Seraphine's mellow songs to Yone's experimental DJ set, there's a vibe for everyone, so feel the sand between your toes, taste the salty air, and lose yourself to the best music of the summer.

160.name: Snow Moon
160.description: As the Snow Moon rises beyond the humbling mountains of Ionia, a chill passes across the land. Those who worship in its name—a cult of unwavering assassins—commence their ritual. With snow comes purification, a cleansing only possible through the sacrifice of one's humanity.

161.name: Star Guardian Season 4
161.description: Ancient enemies appear in a Valoran City scarred by Zoe's invasion, now defended by a new generation of Star Guardians. As darkness gathers in the skies above, Kai'Sa and Akali prepare their untested squad for a fight with forces beyond their comprehension... and the true threat that awaits beyond.

162.name: Monster Tamers
162.description: Who are we? We're Monster Tamers! We protect the world when it's in danger! When others would flee, we follow the roar. We tame the monster and use the CORE. And with our new friends by our side, we'll hop and run and swim and glide! We'll go anywhere, no matter how far. Because we're Monster Tamers! That's who we are!

163.name: Spirit Guard
163.description: Udyr spent almost a decade training in Ionia with the monks of the Hirana Monastery, learning to control and master his spiritual abilities. At last, when the Freljord called him home, he chose to stay and complete his training. In the time since then, Udyr has become part of the Ionian landscape, both spiritual and mortal, as he works with Lee Sin and Karma to return balance to the wartorn land.

164.name: Ruination
164.description: One thousand years ago, the last king of Camavor chose to follow his heart at the expense of his country. So powerful was his love that fate intervened, and only ruin followed.

165.name: Zenith Games
165.description: It's 2122, a year of firsts for the Zenith Games. Robot referees are taking to the field, the sport of Hammerjack is making its competitive debut, and after years of talks, augmented humans are finally allowed to compete. All that's left is seeing who will win.

166.name: Elementalist
166.description: A kingdom hangs on the edge of ruin as an army of titanic elemental beasts wage war on humanity. The last line of defense is held by a lone warrior queen, Elementalist Lux. To save her people, she must look within and reveal her true nature... no matter what form it takes.

167.name: Legacy
167.description: Treasures from days long passed, glimmering just within reach.

168.name: Urf the Manatee
168.description: In loving memory of Urf, a gentle sea cow warrior who now practices with his spatula in the shallow marshes of the great beyond. Good night, sweet prince.

169.name: Surprise Party
169.description: Who doesn't like a surprise party? The guest list is done, everybody's bought their presents, and the food's going to be great. We even got a clown! This'll be one to remember. Just don't tell Amumu.

170.name: Fright Night
170.description: Bounding across the land on gargantuan frog legs, the Toadstool Boarding House attracts lodgers of the most frightful variety. Regardless of where it settles, there is always a monster in need of a place to stay, and Mother Glasc is always there to welcome them into the family with open arms. And an endless labyrinth of rooms ensures that none are ever turned away.

171.name: Spirit Blossom
171.description: The Spirit Blossom Festival is an ancient and celebrated time in Ionia, when the door to the spirit world is opened, the dead return to their loved ones, and spirits of all manner turn their eyes towards the living. From the benevolent Kanmei, to the obsessive Akana—their stories play out again and again, like shadows on a paper lantern.

172.name: Bewitching
172.description: Who said witches can't have fun? Whoever it was, they're probably a frog now. Or some other cursed vermin, doomed to forever wander the streets, watching the eve's celebrations from afar. Pretty harsh punishment, but what did you expect? They may know how to throw a party, but at the end of the night, they're still witches!

173.name: DJ
173.description: Feel the bass. Hear the beat. Let the music move you.

174.name: Popstar
174.description: When you're at the top of the charts, no one can bring you down.

176.name: Three Honors
176.description: Society has become increasingly individualistic and closed off under the Essent's rule. People are encouraged to care only about themselves, so nobody trusts each other. As leader of the long-dead Order of Solace, Malzahar seeks to bring harmony to this dissonant world through the uplifting aura of Solace. He knows that only by coming together can they inspire a better world.

177.name: Bilgewater: Mercs
177.description: Bounty hunters, outlaws, and pirates alike swarm to Bilgewater's infamous slaughter docks like flies to butcher's trimmings. It's a hard life on these seas, but the reward can be well worth it... Bearded Lady permiting.

178.name: Chronicle
178.description: Legends are tested, shaped, and forged by their pasts.

179.name: Curse of the Void
179.description: Should the scourge of the Void spread across Runeterra, all will bow to its twisted evolution. Swarming, hungering, wanting, the Void spares no creature and suffers no defeat.

180.name: Otherroads
180.description: A featherknight flaps its wings, and halfway across Runeterra, an Ocean Drake surfaces. Our lives play out, fickle as words on parchment; the paths before us unknown and exciting. What if the road taken instead... was the one less traveled?

182.name: Beta
182.description: Who let these stay in the build???? Don't tell Legal.

183.name: Soulstealer
183.description: Souls are life, light, power—and in a world without mercy, they are stolen and consumed by remorseless masters of death.

184.name: Triumphant
184.description: Awarded to players who won a League of Legends sponsored tournament.

185.name: True Warrior
185.description: For a true warrior, only strength and honor will echo through eternity.

186.name: Empyrean
186.description: The first Empyrean, Pyke, tears through the realms on a destructive rampage against his counterparts, birthing new Empyreans in the process. Who will reign supreme as these new powerhouses emerge, and what will they do with their rapidly dwindling time left?

187.name: Winterblessed
187.description: When the air grows crisp and the first snow falls, look to the sky, for Polaris will appear. Do not be afraid, for if you've been virtuous without expectation, you might be rewarded with the Aurora's blessings. But remember: no matter how you act, you cannot take your fortunes for granted, because Polaris comes every year, and no one escapes punishment.

188.name: Mythmaker
188.description: Long ago, the defeat of the Great Beast Galio gave rise to Lunar New Year traditions that are carried on through the retelling of that epic tale. Within the story itself lies a living world all its own—but when the world of the story is suddenly interrupted, the characters must work together to fix the mess and see their own myth through.

189.name: Heartthrobs and Heartaches
189.description: The preppy and perfectly poised Heartthrob clique don't have much in common with the Heartache crew, who would much rather be ditching class to hang out at the skatepark. But they agree on one thing: they've had it with this silly made up holiday dedicated to people catching feelings. So why can't they seem to shake the butterflies from their stomachs?

190.name: Broken Covenant
190.description: For years the Aspirant congregation has fought the Neverghaast sect over Aspira, the breath of life. To the congregation, Aspira is a gift one returns upon death to enter the afterlife. But the Neverghaast, cursed with an eternal thirst for breaths, believe there is only one life and it must be lived to excess. The war rages on, with no end in sight...

191.name: Faerie Court
191.description: All fae nobility are servants to nature's will, carrying out the natural order and the turning of seasons with their magic. Beneath that higher purpose, however, a constant game of political intrigue plays out in luxurious courts of silk, gossamer, and gold. Power, after all—magical, natural, or political—always inspires competition.

192.name: Inkshadow
192.description: On the outskirts of Rabadon City, a dilapidated temple houses the last hope for Rabadon's people: the Inkshadow Warriors. Each one sacrifices what is most important to them in order to make a contract with ancient spirits, who imbue them with magic tattoos so powerful, even the Cabal trembles. They are victims no more. It is time to take back their home.

193.name: Nightbringer and Dawnbringer
193.description: Timeless is the conflict between the Nightbringers and Dawnbringers. On one side, the forces of chaos and darkness bring change, while on the other, the forces of order and light bring structure. It is these gods and their descendents that shape a nascent world, and who can say whether the future will yield brighter days... or darker nights.

194.name: World Champions: 2022
194.description: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2022: DRX!

195.name: Crystalis Motus
195.description: Motus was a world bound to magic, but after the purge, everything collapsed. Centuries later, civilization is scattered, nature has reclaimed the cities, and magic's back in the form of Prismae Crystals. All it wants is to spread, and while some can use its power safely, others lose themselves to its pull and are taken over. So begins the Prismae Wars.

196.name: Soul Fighter
196.description: Their souls awaken by trial: one fought on a battlefield or in the very trenches of the mind. Each is granted unique abilities reflective of their nature and the power to conjure forth the very essence of their spirit. Some hone their strength, temper it with training... Others will use it only as a weapon to destroy. They are... SOUL FIGHTERS!

197.name: Street Demons
197.description: In Styxbridge City, demons, creatures, and humans live side-by-side. Every year, a street art festival is held, culminating in a friendly competition to see who can make the biggest and boldest graffiti: TagFest!

198.name: La Ilusión
198.description: The Eidola Vida were once mortal but, upon death, were reborn as spirits of life from their families' love. The Eidola Muerte were forgotten souls who, in death, roamed the afterlife until they found their own makeshift families. Both sides cannot be seen, only felt through their Ardor: magical flames that either help cultivate life or extinguish it.

199.name: HEARTSTEEL
199.description:
“HEARTSTEEL is the hottest new band on the scene, featuring artists like Kayn and Ezreal—”
“It's all of our band!”
“Calm down, Sett.”
“Wait, which magazine is this for again, K'Sante?”
“Please try to focus!”
“Hey Yone, can we just get on stage already?”
“We are—oh, well, Aphelios just walked off…”

200.name: Primal Ambush
200.description: Those lucky enough to be born with glowing markings on their skin are revered among their people as “Favorclaw.” These special Tigrasbornes are destined to represent their community and demand the respect of others with their strength. They each hope to conquer the world in the name of their kind and become the leader feared by all.

201.name: Heavenscale
