201.description: In order to better know their kingdom's subjects, draconic royalty and retinue descend from their palace in the sky, taking on human forms and reveling with the mortals as they usher in the New Year.

202.name: Crystalis Indomitus
202.description: When the Prismae appeared, there were those that learned to hone their magic. But far to the north, the crystals' influence corrupts the very earth itself. Between the fractal undergrowth and iridescent air, creatures join forces with once-human inhabitants in a war against what remains of civilization. Everything will be reflected in the Prismae's image.

203.name: Food Fight
203.description: Both mouthwatering and foe slaughtering, these foods aren't going down without a fight.

204.name: Risen Legends
204.description: Long ago, gods of myth sealed their strength within the four Shards of the Risen: Chaos, Harmony, Patience, and Vigor. Each presented a life-threatening trial to warriors who sought its power, promising to immortalize them in history. To this day, fighters across the land rise to the challenge in hopes of leaving a legacy that even a god will respect.

205.name: Rain Shepherd
205.description: The world is parched, without water and song. Since the frogs lost the power to sing, rains have slowed and moisture is sparse. So frogs have taught a new group to sing: the Rain Shepherds. Clad in special rain gear, they work to replenish the lands and return nature to its formerly lush self.

206.name: Primordian
206.description: Cast from dry land, the Primordians bided their time deep beneath the sea, biding their time for centuries… until they could no longer abide the surface-dwellers any longer, nor their abuses of the planet. Thus the Primordian Queen's judgment was made: humanity's era in the sun is over, and that of the Primordians has only just begun.

207.name: World Champions: 2023
207.description: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2023: T1!

209.name: Chosen of the Wolf
209.description: When the young warleader Ambessa falls in battle, she is granted a vision of Volrachnun, a hallowed afterlife for worthy followers of the Wolf. All who are welcomed into this haven must join the Eternal Chase, finding bliss in battle and joyfully challenging their fellow chosen warriors in a never-ending hunt.

211.name: Masque of the Black Rose
211.description: Revelry and luxury reign at the Silken Danse, a masquerade uniting nobles and luminaries from across Runeterra. But in Noxus, the ballroom is a battlefield. A whisper is as sharp as a dagger, and power is traded between pleasantries. Even the reclusive Lady Elise has left her nest to host the event, in service to unseen eyes… Watching. Waiting.

212.name: Modern Mythos
212.description: Myths and legends happened long ago, but their echoes are still felt to this day. Beneath the surface of the mundane world, mythical power uplifts a new generation of heroes.

213.name: Dumpling Darlings
213.description: Any pastry mage worth their salt knows no get-together is complete without savory treats. Though their cafe may be new, the art of making dumplings isn't—and these magical chefs are willing to knead, chop, fry, and steam their way to culinary greatness. Just one bite of these doughy delights will make even the grumpiest patron eager to pull up a chair and celebrate.

214.name: Masked Justice
214.description: After destroying its own homeworld, the mad giant Mezzorax searched the galaxy until it found a new planet to invade: the bustling metropolis of Ocono. But now an unlikely group of citizens is fighting back. Empowered by alien Hyperguise suits, they will avenge the lives Mezzorax has stolen and end his reign for good.

215.name: Grand Reckoning
215.description: It is Noxian tradition to celebrate a great victory, and the triumph of strength over weakness. After their successful campaign into Freljordian territory, a Grand Reckoning is held in celebration of the returning General Darius and his warbands—drawing crowds to every arena in the capital to honor him, and all the renowned Reckoners of years past.

216.name: Fatemakers and Fatebreakers
216.description: In a world entwined with the Weave of Fate, no thread is beyond reach for those bold enough to seize it. To do so, they must seek the Palace of the Weave and confront the Fatemakers, powerful entities entrusted with the warp and weft of destiny. Those who prove themselves—called Fatebreakers—can rewrite their fortunes... and the shape of things to come.

217.name: Stargazer
217.description: Adept diviners, the Stargazers have long unlocked and safeguarded the secrets of the cosmos within their order's vast library. Using esoteric knowledge and ancient powers, they have shielded their homesphere from countless threats. Yet few among them are prepared to confront an unknown terror emerging from another sphere—or even acknowledge its existence.

218.name: Spirit Blossom Springs
218.description: High in the mountains lies a bathhouse where guests go to melt away their worldly cares. This themed retreat, called "Spirit Blossom Springs," is an oasis free of drama. Its welcoming staff and magical steam wash away the burdens of battle and memories best forgotten. There are no heroes or villains here—only the restful and the rejuvenated.

219.name: Visions of the Fallen
219.description:
“Once, we were gods. Now, lost eternally in the disembodied darkness of our imprisonment, we dream of a thousand inevitable, bloody returns… and all mankind begging for our divine mercy once more.”
In an age lost to legend, this world belonged to the Darkin.
And the Darkin intend to take it back.

220.name: World Champions: 2024
220.description: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2024: T1!

221.name: Flora Fatalis
221.description: The Flora Fatalis judges all who venture within its intoxicating reach, beckoning to those with nerve and ambition, luring them close enough to plant the potent seed of its will. Together they adapt and evolve, seeking ever-stronger hosts to empower—and to consume.

222.name: The Eternal Aspects
222.description: For millennia, the formidably powerful Aspects have worked tirelessly from the celestial realm to guide and strengthen Runeterra. Each one claims to be the ultimate manifestation of a universal truth of creation—indeed, they seek out mortal hosts worthy and capable of furthering their agendas, enabling them to walk the world in physical form once more.

223.name: Sunken Shadows
223.description: While feuding corsairs vie for dominion over the Umbral Seas, something far older stirs below. Few mortals who brave the depths return, and those who do are changed—haunted by whispers of witches and wraiths, relics and ruins from a world long forgotten by the tides.

224.name: The Laws of Stone
224.description: For almost a thousand years, Demacia has stood as a beacon of hope in a world so often darkened by sorcery and ruthless ambition. The foundation of this noble kingdom lies in the mystery of petricite—gleaming stone that can absorb even the most powerful magic—from mighty fortresses, to resplendent works of art that stir the soul of every proud citizen.

225.name: Petals of Spring
225.description: Deep within the spirit realm lies a garden of myth, where each plant embodies mortal hopes, dreams, and suffering. Gardeners tend to it with sacred care, pruning sorrow and nurturing new blossoms. If all goes well, the Frostpyre flowers bloom—signaling the coming melt of snow—and Spring returns, bringing life back to both the garden and the mortal world.

226.name: Aegis Frame
226.description: Caught in the thrall of a dying black hole, one world looks to a neighboring galaxy for sanctuary. To navigate the harsh, uncharted depths of space, they send colossal mechs capable of surviving such a journey to find a new home. When none return, a second mission is mounted, both to carve a new foothold and discover what dangers might await.

227.name: Revenant Reign
227.description: The kingdom has fallen. The dead stir. The Underworld rises. All hail Rex Mortis, the newly-crowned king of death! May his glorious and terrible reign endure forevermore.

228.name: Warhounds
228.description: Across the moonlit wastelands, Warhound bikers howl at the skies, engines growling in reply. They hunt in packs for Quicksilver, liquid moonlight that fuels their chrome-plated machines and imbues them with monstrous power. When rival hunts collide, the desert erupts in claws and sparks—until only one pack lives to howl again.

229.name: Pandemonium
229.description: Through a demon's eyes, emotions blaze in colors only they can see. In this hidden spectrum, every soul is laid bare. When emotions surge beyond control, they flare like beacons, drawing in demons... and the stronger the feeling, the stronger the pull.

230.name: Sinful Shores
230.description: When summer's heat climbs to infernal heights, demons rise from the underworld… for some fun in the sun! Trading in damnation for relaxation, they flock to the seashores eager to swim and soak in the sweltering rays. But mortals beware: when these fiends throw a beach bash, they're sure to raise hell.

231.name: Magma Chamber
231.description: For years, the people of the Forgotten Lands whispered of the vaunted Magma Chamber, a promised place hidden deep below that would rise up and change the world forever. Finally, its great walls have fractured, freeing the dark and slightly odd secrets within...

232.name: World Champions: 2025
232.description: Congratulations to your Worlds winners for 2025: T1!

233.name: Heartsong
233.description: There's a song that connects us all. It's hidden deep within, sleeping until we choose to wake it. Close your eyes and listen. Hear that? That's the magic in your heart, the sound of your soul!

234.name: Classic
234.description: The elders of our world speak in hushed tones of a mystical land that once was. This hallowed place teemed with ancient sorcerers known as "summoners" who would war with one another night and day. Only at the battle's end would they utter the hallowed words of "gg" before departing to revel in their hard-earned runes and quintessences, whatever they are.
